objective: Test whether an analytically motivated budget challenge makes survival differences measurable, without selecting high-A survivors or altering earlier pilot results.
biological_changes: At census 35 clone every original history, including extinct histories as failures. Preserve its inherited genomes and original A expression policy. Change only ovule_budget to the assigned B. All future visitors absent; no mutation, immigration or adult carryover. Never force A to 0.75.
source_gate: Replay all original 144 histories through census 80 with original seeds; match every logged first-I-loss, evolving first-low-A-loss, final occupancy and initial A=0.5 before any companion future. Save complete census-35 PlantState arrays with content hashes.
primary_estimand: [P(alive80|evolving,B4.5)-P(alive80|fixed,B4.5)]-[P(alive80|evolving,B8)-P(alive80|fixed,B8)] with all originally assigned histories retained in each denominator.
secondary_estimands: first HIGH-I loss versus extinction as competing events
source A and I at checkpoint; no mediator adjustment
uncertainty: Descriptive point contrasts and exploratory crossed-axis percentile bootstrap; preserve both policies, both budgets and nested repeat averages. Report 95% and 97.5% marginal sensitivity for survival and alive-accessible interactions. Six source levels per axis do not guarantee nominal coverage.
fixed_scope: One B4.5 challenge at one checkpoint with one fresh matched future stream per existing historical repeat. No outcome-driven grid expansion or reruns with new seeds. Replaying identical seeds for software validation adds no independent evidence.
interpretation_limits: Same historical cohort as PR597, not an independent confirmation or 288 independent islands.
Challenge chosen after the original pilot using its analytical ceiling; companion is prospectively frozen exploratory only.
A-policy differences include its entire evolved history, not isolated direct effects of final A.
Genetic access bound is founder-target-specific and is not actual post-return recovery.
No approved SESOI or #585 joint-power contract; new confirmation remains on HOLD.
